name: WholeStack WF-021: Official ArcGIS Property Source Adapter

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({success:true,request_id:$json.request_id,records:[],message:'No machine-readable ArcGIS FeatureServer/MapServer sources were discovered.'}) }}

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const u=String($json.source.url).replace(/\\/$/,''); if(/\\/(?:FeatureServer|MapServer)\\/\\d+$/i.test(u)) return u; if(/\\/(?:FeatureServer|MapServer)$/i.test(u)) return u+'/0'; return u; })() }}

parameters.jsCode: const source=$('Split GIS Sources').item.json.source; const base=$('Split GIS Sources').item.json; const meta=$json||{}; const fields=Array.isArray(meta.fields)?meta.fields:[]; const lower=fields.map(f=>String(f.name||'').toLowerCase()); const find=(aliases)=>{for(const a of aliases){const i=lower.indexOf(String(a).toLowerCase());if(i>=0)return fields[i];}return null;}; const esc=v=>String(v).replace(/'/g,"''"); const clauses=[]; const applied=[]; const state=find(['SITUSSTATE','SITE_STATE','SSTATE','STATE','STATE_CODE','STATE_NAME','STNAME']); const county=find(['COUNTY','COUNTY_NAME','CNTYNAME','CNTY_NAME','SITUSCOUNTY']); const city=find(['SITUSCITY','SCITY','SITE_CITY','CITY','CITY_NAME','SITUS_CITY']); const zip=find(['SZIP','SITEZIP','SITE_ZIP','ZIP','ZIPCODE','ZIP_CODE']); const add=(f,v,label)=>{if(f&&v){clauses.push(f.name+" = '"+esc(v)+"'");applied.push(label+':'+f.name);}}; add(state,base.state,'state'); add(county,base.county,'county'); add(city,base.city,'city'); if(zip&&base.zip){const numeric=/int|double|float|decimal|number/i.test(String(zip.type||'')); clauses.push(numeric?(zip.name+" = "+(Number(base.zip)||0)):(zip.name+" = '"+esc(base.zip)+"'")); applied.push('zip:'+zip.name);} const delinquent=find(['DELINQUENT_TAX','DELINQ_TAX','DELINQUENT_AMOUNT','TAX_DELINQUENT','DELINQ_AMT']); if(delinquent&&base.criteria.includes('tax_delinquent')&&/int|double|float|decimal|number/i.test(String(delinquent.type||''))){clauses.push(delinquent.name+" > 0");applied.push('tax_delinquent:'+delinquent.name);} const objectId=String(meta.objectIdField||'OBJECTID'); const maxRaw=Number(meta.maxRecordCount||meta.standardMaxRecordCountNoGeometry||1000); const pageSize=Math.max(1,Math.min(base.limit,Number.isFinite(maxRaw)&&maxRaw>0?maxRaw:100)); const supportsPagination=meta.advancedQueryCapabilities?.supportsPagination!==false; const pageCount=supportsPagination?Math.min(10,Math.ceil(base.limit/pageSize)):1; return Array.from({length:pageCount},(_,i)=>({json:{...base,metadata:meta,source,layer_url:meta.url||source.url,where:clauses.length?clauses.join(' AND '):'1=1',query_filters_applied:applied,object_id_field:objectId,page_index:i,result_offset:i*pageSize,result_record_count:Math.min(pageSize,base.limit-i*pageSize),supports_pagination:supportsPagination,pagination_limit_reached:!supportsPagination&&base.limit>pageSize}}));

const all=$input.all(); const meta=all[0]?.json||{}; const raw=all.flatMap(i=>Array.isArray(i.json.records)?i.json.records:[]); const seen=new Set(); const records=[]; for(const r of raw){const key=[r.parcel_id,r.source_record_id,r.property_address,r.owner_name].map(v=>String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase()).join('|'); if(seen.has(key))continue; seen.add(key); records.push(r);} return [{json:{success:true,request_id:meta.request_id,records:records.slice(0,meta.limit||100),record_count:records.length,sources_checked:new Set(all.map(i=>i.json.source_url).filter(Boolean)).size,pages_checked:all.length,query_filters_applied:[...new Set(all.flatMap(i=>i.json.query_filters_applied||[]))],limitations:[...new Set(all.flatMap(i=>i.json.limitations||[]))]}}];
